instruction.name: vext2xv.w.b
instruction.description: Sign-extend the lowest 8 8-bit elements of `a` to 32-bit elements.

experiments.name: dependent vector chain
experiments.notes: Consecutive unrolled copies form a vector-register dependency chain. Measured with unroll=100000 to amortise call overhead.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: vext2xv.w.b $xr0, $xr8; vext2xv.w.b $xr1, $xr9; vext2xv.w.b $xr2, $xr10; vext2xv.w.b $xr3, $xr11; vext2xv.w.b $xr4, $xr12; vext2xv.w.b $xr5, $xr13; vext2xv.w.b $xr6, $xr14; vext2xv.w.b $xr7, $xr15
throughput.init: li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr15, $r4
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --init 'li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr15, $r4' --asm 'vext2xv.w.b $xr0, $xr8; vext2xv.w.b $xr1, $xr9; vext2xv.w.b $xr2, $xr10; vext2xv.w.b $xr3, $xr11; vext2xv.w.b $xr4, $xr12; vext2xv.w.b $xr5, $xr13; vext2xv.w.b $xr6, $xr14; vext2xv.w.b $xr7, $xr15'
throughput.notes: 8 independent instructions take 1.99 cycles. The measured CPI 0.2487 is the nominal 0.25 within measurement noise; the value is reported as the nominal figure.

notes: LASX vector instruction. Measured on LA664 with register-only operands; latency uses a dependent chain (unroll=100000), throughput uses 8 independent lanes (unroll=1000).
